title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in the APPAM system.

collection.title: 1. Data Collection
collection.content: We collect personal information required for managing public witnessing in metropolitan areas, including names, contact numbers, email addresses, congregation details, and volunteer status.

use.title: 2. Data Usage
use.content: The collected data is strictly used for cart shift scheduling, attendance confirmation, operational communication, and validation with local coordinators.

security.title: 3. Security & Confidentiality
security.content: We enforce strict technical and organizational security measures. System access is strictly controlled via authentication and role-based permissions.

retention.title: 4. Data Retention & Rights
retention.content: Users may request review, update, or removal of their registered data through official support channels or via their respective zone coordinators.
